# Use cases

<!-- generated by catalog/kf_catalogo.py render from docs/catalogo.json: edit the JSON, not this file -->

Each use case links to the test that runs it end to end, or `por cobrir`. Edge cases: [edge-cases.md](edge-cases.md).

| ID | I want to... | Run | You get | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| UC-001 | Start a project with the Kaizen workflow | `kaizen init --harness codex` | skills, prompts, `sp-*` scripts, an `AGENTS.md` block; existing files are kept | `tests/adapters.test.js::AGENTS.md existente é preservado e recebe o bloco` |
| UC-002 | Check the install is healthy (CI, new machine) | `kaizen doctor --harness codex` | rc 0 when complete, rc 1 and a list of what is missing | `tests/adapters.test.js::doctor falha (rc≠0) quando falta uma peça` |
| UC-003 | Repair a broken or partial install | `kaizen doctor --harness codex --fix` | missing pieces restored, nothing overwritten | `tests/cli-hardening.test.js::doctor falha numa instalação em falta e --fix repõe sem sobrescrever` |
| UC-004 | See what my agents cost this month | `kaizen usage --days 30` | totals by day, model, session and 5 h window (API-equivalent USD) | `tests/test_usage.py::ReportTest::test_usage_totals_and_unpriced_warning` |
| UC-005 | Compare Claude and Codex spend | `kaizen usage --source claude,codex` | one table across both transcript stores | `tests/test_usage.py::ReportTest::test_source_filter` |
| UC-006 | Keep a weekly record | `kaizen report --week 2026-W42` | a metrics-only Markdown note in `reportsDir` | `tests/test_usage.py::ReportTest::test_report_writes_week_file_metrics_only` |
| UC-007 | Price a model not in the bundled table | add it to your prices file, set `"prices"` in `kaizen.config.json` | cost instead of `n/a` | `tests/test_usage.py::ReportTest::test_config_prices_make_codex_priceable` |
| UC-008 | List my open stories | `kaizen status` | pending SPs by status and priority | `por cobrir` |
| UC-009 | Cost of one period only | `kaizen usage --since 2026-10-01` | same tables from that date | `por cobrir` |
| UC-010 | Show only one harness | `kaizen usage --source codex --top 10` | Codex only, top 10 sessions | `por cobrir` |
| UC-011 | Read transcripts copied from another machine | `kaizen usage --codex-root ./backup/sessions` | totals from that folder | `por cobrir` |
| UC-012 | Preview a weekly report without writing | `kaizen report --week 2026-W42 --print` | Markdown on stdout | `por cobrir` |
| UC-013 | Write reports somewhere else | `kaizen report --out docs/usage` | `docs/usage/YYYY-WNN.md` | `por cobrir` |
| UC-014 | Plan a feature as a story | `python scripts/sp-new.py --project _default --slug login --priority P2` | an empty 8-section story in `sp/TODO` | `core/scripts/test_sp_new.py::test_cli_imprime_caminho_e_rc` |
| UC-015 | Plan a feature with dependent children | `python scripts/sp-new.py --project _default --program billing --children "api,ui:api" --priority P2` | parent + two children, `ui` waits for `api` | `core/scripts/test_sp_new.py::test_cli_program_expande_filhos_e_dependencias` |
| UC-016 | Start and finish a story | `python scripts/sp-move.py login doing` / `done --next` | story moves folders; `--next` opens the next child | `core/scripts/test_sp_move.py::test_next_fecha_o_filho_e_abre_o_proximo_elegivel` |
| UC-017 | Check stories are well-formed | `python scripts/sp-validate.py path/to/story.md` | rc 1 if a section is missing or empty | `core/scripts/test_sp_validate.py::test_cli_rc0_e_rc1_com_lista` |
| UC-018 | Keep CI honest about leaks | `kaizen audit .` | rc 1 if personal data is found | `tests/audit.test.js::cada padrão proibido plantado é detetado` |
| UC-019 | See what a handoff would do | `python scripts/sp-handoff.py --launch path/to/story.md --dry-run` | the commands, nothing executed | `por cobrir` |
| UC-020 | Run several ready stories in a row | `/sp-fila --dry-run`, then `/sp-fila` | order and exclusions first; then each `modo: auto` story with `gates:` runs in a clean session | `core/scripts/test_sp_fila_eleg.py::test_cli_dry_run_mostra_ordem_e_exclusoes` |
| UC-021 | Run independent stories in parallel | `/sp-fila --concorrencia 3` | up to 3 panes, one worktree each; a watcher reports each one as it ends | `core/scripts/test_sp_fila_paralelo.py::test_concorrencia_so_lanca_ate_ao_teto` |
| UC-022 | Scan a diff for security slips | `python scripts/pentest.py --repo . --base main` | rc 1 and the findings; add `--criar-sps --project _default` for one story each | `core/scripts/test_pentest.py::PentestTest::test_falha_plantada_detetada` |
| UC-023 | Loop fix and review until approved | `python scripts/review_ciclo.py review.json --achados achados.txt` | `APROVADO`, `CORRIGIR` or `ESCALAR` | `core/scripts/test_review_ciclo.py::CicloTest::test_reprovado_corrige_e_repete_ate_aprovar` |
| UC-024 | Draft the PR body | `python scripts/pr_corpo.py path/to/story.md --review review.json` | body from the story, pen test and review; add `--criar` to open it | `core/scripts/test_pr_corpo.py::PrTest::test_dry_run_imprime_e_nunca_cria` |
| UC-025 | Hand off a conversation with no story | `/handoff` | ephemeral file; the fresh context reads and deletes it | `core/scripts/test_handoff.py::test_retoma_so_com_o_handoff_regista_campos_e_apaga` |
| UC-026 | Run a command on workflow events | add [`kaizen-hooks.json`](config.md#kaizen-hooksjson) | `kaizen_hooks.py fire` runs it | `core/scripts/test_kaizen_hooks.py::test_dispara_com_env_e_stdin` |
| UC-027 | Move to a fresh context mid-story | `/sp-handoff` | resume command injected in the pane, or copied to the clipboard | `core/scripts/test_sp_handoff.py::test_main_write_sincroniza_o_mae` |
| UC-028 | Choose how a program's children run | `sp-execucao.py <parent> sequencial\|paralelo` | sets `execucao:` on the parent story; `/michi` and `/sp-fila` read it | `core/scripts/test_sp_execucao.py::test_sem_valor_por_escolher_e_depois_grava` |
| UC-029 | Measure edge case and use case coverage | `kaizen catalog` (`--check`, `render`, `--json`) | covered/total for EC and UC; rc 0 only at EC >= 0.9 and UC = 1.0 | `tests/catalog.test.js::kaizen catalog --check valida o catálogo do repo` |
| UC-030 | Resume a story after a crash, Ctrl+C or closed pane | `kaizen resume <story>` | continues from the last journaled phase and step | `core/scripts/test_sp_resume.py::test_um_candidato_retoma_ec001` |
| UC-031 | Resume from a chosen phase | `kaizen resume <story> --from <phase>` | earlier phases kept, the run restarts at that phase | `core/scripts/test_sp_resume.py::test_from_fase_reverte_abertos_a_partir_dela` |
| UC-032 | Throw away a broken run and start the story again | `kaizen resume <story> --restart` | journal reset, story back to its first phase, files kept | `core/scripts/test_sp_resume.py::test_restart_confirmado_arquiva_sem_apagar_uc032` |
| UC-033 | Run a whole program from its parent | `/sp-fila --programa <parent>` | children run in the parent's `execucao:` order; the parent closes after the last one | `por cobrir` |
| UC-034 | Continue a program from a child already started | `/sp-fila --programa <parent>` with a child in Doing | the running child is resumed, not relaunched; the rest follow | `por cobrir` |
